question: An engineer must create a new Cisco UCS user account to perform these actions: modify systems logs, faults, and power management settings; and view access to all other configuration in the UCS domain. Which two roles must be assigned to the user to permit these actions? (Choose two.)
theory: Cisco UCS Manager's Operations role provides read/write access to system logs (including syslog servers) and faults, while the Facility Manager role provides read/write access to power-management operations such as fan speed and power redundancy - both roles also grant read-only visibility into the rest of the system by default. Together they exactly satisfy 'modify logs/faults/power settings, view everything else' without granting the broader write access that Administrator or Server Compute would provide. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 19 - Securing UCS Management, Default User Roles)
